descriptions.notStarted: Lately I see a strange group of people wandering all over the Maple World. They display confident looks with weapons I have never seen anywhere else...and a scent of the ocean to boot. Who are they really? I better ask #b#p9010010##k for more information on these strangers.
descriptions.inProgress: #p9010010# was making quite a scene about ''them'' having finally arrived. The "they" she referred to was the #bPirates#k! Cassandra proposed that if I was interested in the Pirates, then she'll allow me to experience a small dose of that. I'll just have to prove it to her that I am indeed interested in the Pirates... I better answer the #bquestions#k Cassandra asks and earn #b#t2210010##k!
descriptions.completed: I received #b#t2210010##k from #p9010010#. With this, I may be able to experience the mysterious skills of the Pirates!  I should also stop by the Nautilus, near Hensys and see them for myself!
